therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Immunomodulation through passive antibody transfer and immune system regulation
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Reduction of autoimmune attack on acetylcholine receptors at neuromuscular junction
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Corticosteroid dependent patients with generalized myasthenia gravis
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Percent of subjects achieving 50% or greater reduction in corticosteroid dose from baseline to week 39

subgroup_findings: In 15-40 mg/day baseline dose subgroup: IGIV-C 58.6% vs Placebo 60.7%
In 41-60 mg/day baseline dose subgroup: both groups achieved 100% response rate
safety_signals: Myasthenia gravis worsening more frequent in IGIV-C group (4/30) vs placebo (1/30)
Myasthenia gravis crisis: IGIV-C 1/30 vs placebo 2/30
Multiple serious infections in placebo group
results.dose_information: Loading dose: 2 g/kg IGIV-C, then maintenance: 1 g/kg every 3 weeks for up to 36 weeks
